Overview

Bakersfield is a city in CA with a population of 407,615. California’s affordable option with agriculture, oil, and country music heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9b growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 272 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 31.9.
